# CDC community water fluoridation fixture

Fixture type: author-created paraphrase for deterministic testing.
Original source: https://www.cdc.gov/mmwr/volumes/72/wr/mm7222a1.htm
Publisher: Centers for Disease Control and Prevention
Published: 2023-06-02

The U.S. Public Health Service target for community water fluoridation is 0.7 mg/L.

CDC reports that fluoridation at the recommended level reduces dental caries in
children and adults. The report describes dental fluorosis as a known effect of
excess exposure during tooth development and distinguishes the preventive
target from higher regulatory limits.

The operational dataset covered 4,080 reporting systems from 2016 through 2021.
The report also notes incomplete reporting by adjusting systems as a limitation.
